THE OTUNCARES APPROACH

See the person.
Know the next step.

Care records should help a team understand someone, not just complete a form. Otuncares connects what matters to a person with what needs doing today.

01 / CONTEXT

A person, beyond a profile.

Keep preferences, meaningful goals and agreed support alongside everyday tasks.

02 / ACTION

A shift with a clear focus.

Review open tasks, record an observation and prepare a handover from one workspace.

03 / CONTINUITY

Carry the story forward.

Make relevant notes easy to find, so the next colleague has the context they need.
